commit_message:
[Merged] In the decimal extension, an optional second argument to the decimal() and decimal_exp() functions rounds the value to the number of significant digits specified by that argument.

FossilOrigin-Name: cb24edf1afc3f9083a4963c5fe232933eccc7c0cb8872aa5fcd336d226b885ef
pr_title: Support significant-digit rounding in decimal SQL functions
pr_description: Allow decimal() and decimal_exp() to accept an optional second argument specifying the number of significant digits. The rounding helper returns immediately for a NULL decimal pointer, preserving the existing result handling when no decimal value is available.

intro_commit_message:
In the decimal extension, an optional second argument to the decimal() and decimal_exp() functions rounds the value to the number of significant digits specified by that argument.

FossilOrigin-Name: cb24edf1afc3f9083a4963c5fe232933eccc7c0cb8872aa5fcd336d226b885ef
fix_commit_message:
Fix a NULL pointer dereference in the (undocumented) two-argument version of the decimal() extension SQL function. [forum:/forumpost/fa9c2dc83f|Forum post fa9c2dc83f].

FossilOrigin-Name: a0266351df8700383d50c2ef2d179dd82b0e0fd7fc70d05a91d5e4e845983b46
agent_reasoning: The two-argument feature calls decimal_round() before the caller checks whether the Decimal pointer is NULL. Without a guard, positive precision values can cause the helper to dereference NULL. The sole source edit adds the upstream p==0 early return before any pointer access, retaining the feature and existing behavior for valid decimal values. No tests or Fossil metadata were edited. Workspace validation passed against intro_parent.
